verdict.rationale: Headless or automated access is a fair question for an online filing and search service, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only an interactive web portal (SOSPortal) with drafts, a shopping cart, a My Submissions page and multi-factor authentication. Nothing documents an API, CLI, or any other programmatic or CI-friendly access path. The filing host's robots.txt also disallows AI crawlers and agents by name, which points away from sanctioned automation.
